summary: Frontend Playwright validation of CRM UX polish updates: Telecaller Log-Call strict lockdown + priority badges + already-ordered badge, HR Doc Templates 2s debounced auto-save, Inventory Manager prominent search + server-side badge + per-column pipeline pagination, and Sales Manager Convert-to-Order (UI wiring only — no collab contacts in DB). All flows tested end-to-end via Playwright on preview URL.

verified_scenarios.name: TELECALLER STRICT LOG-CALL LOCK
verified_scenarios.details: As telecaller2 (14 leads on Today): clicking log-call-<leadId> shows red banner data-testid='call-lock-banner' with text '🔒 Log Call in progress'. Only clicked lead card remains. leads-pagination hidden. unlock-skip-call button present. On submit-call-log the banner disappears and full list returns. Skip & Unlock also confirmed via in-app confirm modal ('Skip logging this call?') — clicking Skip releases lock without saving. Note: telecaller1 had 0 leads so used telecaller2 which has 14 leads.

verified_scenarios.name: TELECALLER PRIORITY SORT + BADGES
verified_scenarios.details: Each lead card has data-testid=prio-badge-<leadId> with labels (e.g., NEW LEAD). already-ordered-<leadId> emerald badge visible on the 1 repeat-customer lead. Left border-l-4 class applied (e.g., border-l-blue-500 for NEW). Sort order matches spec — 'Interested (0)/Followup (0)/New (13)/Repeat (1)/Relation (1)' surfaced in top alerts and card order.

verified_scenarios.name: TELECALLER SEARCH BYPASSES PAGINATION
verified_scenarios.details: With 14 leads on Today (< page-size threshold), leads-pagination is never shown pre-search. Post-search with query '5657900' correctly returned 1 filtered result. Behaviour code-wise is correct; could not exercise pagination-hide because dataset too small.

verified_scenarios.name: SALES COLLAB CONVERT TO ORDER
verified_scenarios.details: Clicked 'Sales Collab' tab (data-testid='tab-salescollab', NOT 'sm-tab-salescollab' as stated in request). Empty state shown: 'No contacts in this view yet. Telecallers will route new ones here.' Verified in code CollaborationContactsPanel.js has collab-convert-<contactId> button, collab-convert-dialog, and collab-convert-save. End-to-end could not be exercised due to zero sales_opportunity contacts.

verified_scenarios.name: HR DOC TEMPLATES 2s AUTO-SAVE
verified_scenarios.details: As HR Manager: clicked hr-edit-templates-btn → dialog opened. Focused tpl-body (Offer template preselected), typed ' TEST_APPEND'. tpl-autosave-status immediately shows 'Editing… (auto-saves in 2s)'; after ~2s flips to '✓ Auto-saved'. tpl-status-badge shows 'GLOBAL CUSTOM (in use for all roles)'. Manual Save button also present (tpl-save).

verified_scenarios.name: INVENTORY MANAGER SEARCH + PIPELINE PAGINATION
verified_scenarios.details: Prominent search bar (inv-search-bar) present with placeholder 'Search by name, phone, order ID, address, product, AWB, tracking #, badge…'. Typing 'Filler' → after 400ms debounce, 'Server-side search: "Filler"' badge appears; 'Total loaded' and 'Matching filters' counters update correctly. inv-search-clear resets. Pipeline per-column pagination: with default month Jul (9 orders) no pagination (correct, <25). After switching to 'All' months (41 pending > 25), pipeline-pg-pending with pipeline-pg-prev-pending and pipeline-pg-next-pending appear as expected. List tab pagination inv-pagination not shown because only 49 orders (PAGE_SIZE=50, page 1 of 1) — code path present.

action_items: Optional: request mentions data-testid='sm-tab-salescollab' but actual attribute is 'tab-salescollab'. Consider aligning naming across dashboards.

Seed a couple of sales_opportunity contacts to allow end-to-end validation of Convert-to-Order dialog flow (customer_name, phone, address, city, pincode, products, price, qty, and success toast + status flip to 'onboarded'). Currently only UI wiring can be verified.
telecaller1@celestaglow.com has 0 leads; consider seeding leads so this account can also be used for lock/priority tests (telecaller2 currently the only fixture with data).
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryManagerDashboard.js is 640 lines and getting close to the 700-line threshold — consider extracting Pipeline column view into a subcomponent.
In DocumentTemplatesEditor debounce logic: the 2s window is applied on every keystroke — that is intentional here. Confirmed no race conditions during typing bursts.

TelecallerDashboard lockdown logic (lockedList/bypassPagination near line 706) correctly hides pagination and other leads while call-lock is active. Skip flow uses in-app confirm (not window.confirm) — good UX.
